text: 国庆长假前一周至长假后开市首日，沪市股票ETF合计净流入369亿元，其中宽基ETF净流入252亿元，科创50ETF资金净流入150亿元，反映各类投资者对权益市场尤其科创板市场长期配置价值的认可。近期，低风险、稳收益ETF产品布局持续提速。证监会网站显示，节前包括沪市8只中证红利增长ETF在内的多只产品集中上报，进一步丰富沪市多元化投资工具体系。市场人士指出，近年来，沪市ETF市场不断吸引增量资金流入，产品布局日益丰富，投资生态持续完善，市场活力和吸引力不断提升，为资本市场平稳健康发展注入持久动力。（央视新闻）
text_en: In the week before the National Day holiday through the first trading day after the holiday, stock ETFs in the Shanghai market saw a total net inflow of 36.9 billion yuan, including 25.2 billion yuan into broad-based ETFs and 15 billion yuan into STAR 50 ETFs, reflecting recognition by various investors of the long-term allocation value of the equity market, especially the STAR Market. Recently, the launch of low-risk, stable-return ETF products has continued to accelerate. According to the CSRC website, before the holiday, multiple products were filed in a concentrated manner, including eight CSI Dividend Growth ETFs in the Shanghai market, further enriching the Shanghai market's diversified investment tool system. Market participants noted that in recent years, the Shanghai ETF market has continued to attract incremental capital inflows, with an increasingly rich product lineup and a continuously improving investment ecosystem, while market vitality and attractiveness keep rising, injecting lasting momentum into the stable and healthy development of the capital market. (CCTV News)
